newsitem.title: USA: Houston files to offer 20 mln in securities.
newsitem.headline: Houston files to offer 20 mln in securities.

text.p: Houston Industries Inc filed Monday with the Securities and Exchange Commission a shelf registration for 20 million in percent automated common exchange securities.
At maturity, the principal amount of each security will be mandatorily exchanged by the company for an undetermined number of shares of Time Warner Inc common, Houston said in the filing.

Houston granted the underwriters a 30-day over-allotment option to purchase up to 2,909,040 additional shares. The offering will be made through Goldman Sachs & Co, Credit Suisse First Boston and Merrill Lynch & Co.
Net proceeds will be added to the company's general corporate funds and will be used to retire outstanding commercial paper and for general corporate purposes.
The combined 22.9 million shares at a proposed maximum offering of $47.31 per share is estimated to generate a maximum aggregate offering of $1,083,883,955.
Houston, based in Houston, Texas, is a holding company operating principally in the electric utility business. Houston Lighting and Power Co is a principal subsidiary.
